name: jarvis-web
description: Jarvis's web app: the face, voice, and chat I open from my phone and laptop over Tailscale.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.client.json && tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json && node scripts/copy-assets.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.client.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json --noEmit
